newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 11.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on August 11. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Political analysts say the ruling Golkar party will be badly hit if it replaces legislators who are members of the Indonesian Association of Islamic Intellectuals (ICMI).
A leading political analyst has called for the next vice-president to be given a bigger role to help reduce President Suharto's work load.

Fifty-one armed forces members have been caught in the latest sweep by military authorities in the capital Jakarta to enforce regulations prohibiting security force members from frequenting night clubs and other entertainment venues.

Housing minister Akbar Tanjung says the cost of housing, especially the average home, will increase as a result of the government tightening monetary policy in the wake of a speculative attack on the rupiah.
Most new members of the 500-seat Indonesian parliament attended the opening of an unprecedented four week oreintation and guidance course provided by the government.
